bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $800 和 200 日均线

read.en: Lumentum fell 11.5% on Oct 22 to $752.54, trading between $746.23 and $811.00. It is below the falling 5-day ($816.9), 10-day ($893.7), 30-day ($945.7) and 100-day ($872.3) averages and now the rising 200-day ($786.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($999.54), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月22日下跌 11.5%，收于 $752.54，盘中区间 $746.23–811.00。股价位于下行的 5 日（$816.9）、10 日（$893.7）、30 日（$945.7）和 100 日均线（$872.3）下方，并跌破上行的 200 日均线（$786.2）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$999.54），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The drop broke $832, $819, $800 (Oct 15 low), $785 (Oct 20 low) and the 200-day, all now resistance. Resistance is $784.5–787 (200-day, August lows), then $800–819 (Oct 15 low, 5-day, Sep 3 low) and $832. Support is $746 (Oct 22 low), then $680.4 and $650.8 (July lows). A close above $787 would target $819; a close below $746 would open $680.
